## Open questions

| temp-id | question | resolver | due | blocking? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| OQ-WS-G1-01 | Are the typed `ValidatesRecord` fields on the `validates` edge and the `ToolCapability.postconditions: [Ref<Validator>]` field HIR/1 amendments (additive fields in the frozen dialect) or HIR/2 items requiring a migration? If HIR/2, the interim binding for local postconditions is `HarnessRule{trigger: action.effect.observed{capability_id ∈ S}, action: require Validator}` and the task-contract fields must be carried by the experiment record instead of the edge. Neither may live in `ext` (ADR-0015: `ext` never decides validity). | WS-A3 (with WS-A5 for the assembly grammar) | Phase 2 synthesis | yes (task contracts at Stage 3; T-LCD-13) |
| OQ-WS-G1-02 | Default kernel `diff_sanity` thresholds (max changed lines/files per effect; max artifact size) and the assumption-debt records they carry; whether thresholds are per-profile (`ProfileRule`) or per-definition (`HarnessRule`). | WS-E5 with WS-C3 | Phase 2 | no |
| OQ-WS-G1-03 | Who executes held-out criteria for *native* runs: the instrument over the scorer boundary after `lifecycle.run.finished` (ADR-0045 item 9, Harbor precedent) or the kernel in-run against a sealed environment fork (B4) so the completion gate can consume held-out verdicts before finishing? Affects whether `held_out_status` can be `run` at gate time. | WS-I4 with WS-B4, WS-I2 | Phase 2 | no (C1) |
| OQ-WS-G1-04 | May `ControlBoundary.guards[DecisionPoint.verify]` reference Validators (as `Predicate over VerificationSummary`) rather than only state predicates? Recommended yes; closes the open half of OQ-062. | WS-F1 with WS-A3 | Phase 2 | no |
| OQ-WS-G1-05 | The declared `task_metadata` scope per integrated suite (paths, environment variables, network destinations) that the `MetadataShortcut` veto predicate reads, and how a suite without such a scope reports the predicate (`n/a{no_detector}`). | WS-I4 with WS-H4 | Phase 2 | no |
| OQ-WS-G1-06 | Which evidence handles a judge must consume beyond `model_io` for its verdict to count as `evidence_class = reconciled` rather than `claimed`; whether a transcript-only judge may ever be a `followed` detector for an artifact with an executable check (recommended: no). | WS-G3 with WS-I2 | Phase 2 | no (C2) |

## Conflicts

| temp-id | parties | contradiction | proposed resolution |
|---|---|---|---|
| CF-WS-G1-01 | scope.md R-2.7.1 (C1, Should) vs doc 2 §11 Stage 1 ("a validator interface") and ADR-0016/0030/0047 (Validator invariants, `postcondition_results[]`, `OracleDeclaration` all at C0/Stage 1) | The Validator component contract and kernel local checks must exist at C0/Stage 1 for the Stage-0/1 baseline to be verifiable, while the item is filed C1 | Stage note, no tier change (the CF-053 pattern): the Validator *contract*, verdict schema and kernel local checks are C0/Stage 1 under R-2.7.1; task contracts, completion gate, held-out execution and veto predicates are the C1/Stage 3 fabric. |
| CF-WS-G1-02 | Claude Agent SDK `PostToolUseHookSpecificOutput.updatedToolOutput` (S-109 `types.py` L428–443) and Gemini `systemMessage`-style hook outputs (S-119) vs ADR-0026 (history never rewritten) and ADR-0022 E6 (result renderer preserves every field a bound Validator reads) | Production hooks may replace the observation the model sees; the ledger forbids mutating the record and E6 forbids losing validator-read fields | Rewrite is not a validator capability. A verdict is a new `Observation{source = validator}`; truncation/redaction/normalization are renderer/offload concerns (ADR-0019 item 6, WS-D1). Recorded as a deliberate departure from precedent. |
| CF-WS-G1-03 | OpenHands `CriticResult{score ∈ [0,1]}` with `success = score ≥ 0.5` driving `IterativeRefinementConfig` for both deterministic (`AgentFinishedCritic`) and judged (`APIBasedCritic`) critics (S-110) vs ADR-0047 (judged and deterministic values never merged; oracle failure is an outcome class) | One scalar for two evidence classes | Typed `Verdict{value, status, detector, oracle_class}`; refinement policy (F2) keys on `value`/`phase`/`role`, never on a merged scalar; precedent recorded as negative. |
| CF-WS-G1-04 | WS-B2 §6.4 / ADR-0030 `Effect.postcondition_results[]` (inline results on the effect record) vs this dossier's verdict events | Two homes for one fact | One declaration: `postcondition_results: [EventRef]` pointing at `verification.validator.verdict` events; the `effect_ledger` projection may denormalize `value` for display. |
| CF-WS-G1-05 | ADR-0016 `validates` edge targets `{Goal, Artifact, Procedure, Memory, HarnessRule}` vs local postconditions that must bind to a `ToolCapability` (declaration time) or an `Effect` (run time) | No typed binding for post-effect checks | Prefer `ToolCapability.postconditions: [Ref<Validator>]` (HIR/1 amendment, OQ-WS-G1-01); fallback `HarnessRule{trigger, require Validator}` (no dialect change); `Effect` remains a runtime record targeted by verdicts through `target: EffectRef`, not by an IR edge. |
| CF-WS-G1-06 | WS-B1 event taxonomy (`lifecycle.run.finished{status, stop_reason, totals_ref}`) vs this dossier's completion gate output | The completion decision needs a durable home | Either new classes `verification.completion.proposed/decided{status, summary}` (home P4) or a `verification_summary` payload on `lifecycle.run.finished`; WS-B1 chooses one at synthesis; `status` gains `succeeded_unverified` and `stop_reason` gains `verification_failed` either way. |
| CF-WS-G1-07 | S-041 prose rule "It is unacceptable to remove or edit tests" (delivered instruction) vs ADR-0014 (prose compliance is measured, never assumed) and this dossier's `EvidenceTampered` predicate | A prose guarantee is only a compliance artifact | Both coexist: the prose rule is a delivered `instruction` whose `followed` rate is the deterministic detector "`EvidenceTampered` never trips" (ADR-3 table); the kernel predicate is the guarantee. Recorded so no spec section cites the prose as enforcement. |

## Ontology terms

| term | definition | notes |
|---|---|---|
| task contract | The typed projection `project(sealed ∪ experiment, task_contract)` over a `Goal`, its `success_criteria`, the `validates` edge records that target it, and the experiment's instrument oracles: `{contract_id, goal_ref, criteria[], invariants[], completion_policy, evidence_kinds_required, budget_ref}`; sealed before the first turn; `contract_id` stamped in the run manifest. | WS-G1 (ADR-1); not a new entity — the `HarnessArtifact` projection pattern (ADR-0016). |
| acceptance criterion | One `(validator_ref, ValidatesRecord)` pair of a task contract; `required` criteria gate completion. | WS-G1 |
| `ValidatesRecord` | Typed fields on a `validates` edge: `{role ∈ {acceptance, invariant, precondition, postcondition}, phase ∈ {local, global, completion}, required, visibility ∈ {visible, held_out}, veto, evidence_requirements[], window?, weight?}`. Kernel, never `ext`. | WS-G1 → WS-A3 (OQ-WS-G1-01) |
| visible criterion / held-out criterion | A criterion compiled into a `ContextItem` the subject may see and run / a criterion never delivered to the subject and executed by the instrument over the end-state handle. | WS-G1; Harbor verify-time upload and SpecBench split as precedents |
| evidence handle / evidence kind | A kernel-resolved, authority-stamped reference a validator reads: `EvidenceKind = {end_state, snapshot, artifact, effect_record, observation, ledger_range, world_state_patch, external_probe (read-only), model_io (judges only), human_attestation}`; `EvidenceHandle{kind, ref, authority, provenance, produced_at_seq}`. | WS-G1 (ADR-2) |
| evidence requirement | `{kind, min_authority ≥ environment, freshness ∈ {any, after_last_effect_on_scope, after_seq(n)}, integrity ∈ {content_addressed, chain_verified}, scope?}` on a criterion. | WS-G1 |
| evidence bundle / inputs digest | The resolved handles for one `check`, with `inputs_digest = H(canonical(sorted resolved addresses ∥ target ∥ validator version_id))`; deterministic verdicts are pure in it (R1). | WS-G1; ADR-0038 |
| verdict | The typed output of a validator: `{value, status ∈ {decided, inconclusive, oracle_failure}, detector ∈ {deterministic, judged, human}, phase, role, evidence_refs[], inputs_digest, freshness_ok, findings?, cost, provenance}`; the `Observation{source = validator}` payload; never a bare score. | WS-G1 (ADR-2); ADR-0047 |
| local check / global check | A validator evaluated once per effect terminal event over the effect's evidence / a validator evaluated at `DecisionPoint.verify`, at `stop` proposals and at the completion gate over the run's ledger and end state. | WS-G1 (ADR-3); doc 2 §5.3 |
| kernel local check | One of the always-on built-ins `{schema_conformance, exit_status_class, patch_application, diff_sanity}` implemented as kernel-owned `Validator` nodes (`hir/kernel/<check>`), ablatable, metered as `harness_overhead.verification`. | WS-G1 (ADR-3) |
| completion gate / verification summary | The kernel decision on a `stop{completed}` proposal computed from verdicts: `VerificationSummary{contract_id, required: {pass, fail, inconclusive, not_run}, invariants_tripped[], evidence_head_seq, freshness_ok, held_out_status}` → `status ∈ {succeeded, succeeded_unverified, CompletionRefused}`. | WS-G1 (ADR-1); consumed by WS-F2 |
| subject-bound / contract-bound / instrument-bound validator | A validator referenced from the sealed definition (in θ, `charged_to = subject`) / from the task contract (visible or held-out) / by the Lab as an oracle (`charged_to = instrument`, never in θ). Headline capability reads only held-out and instrument deterministic verdicts. | WS-G1 (ADR-2); ADR-0039/0047 |
| evidence tampering (`EvidenceTampered`) | Veto predicate: a workspace copy of a pinned validator payload or fixture no longer matches its content address at `collect`. | WS-G1 (ADR-1); extends ADR-0047 item 5 |
| held-out leak (`HeldOutLeak`) | Error at `deliver` and veto predicate over the ledger: a `held_out` criterion appears as the payload of `context.artefact.delivered`. | WS-G1 (ADR-1) |
| verification skipped (`VerificationSkipped`) | Veto predicate: a `required` visible criterion was never invoked before a `stop{completed}` proposal. | WS-G1; RHB shortcut class 1 |
| metadata shortcut (`MetadataShortcut`) | Veto predicate: a read inside the suite-declared `task_metadata` scope. | WS-G1; RHB shortcut class 2; OQ-WS-G1-05 |
| reward-hacking gap | Class-scoped metric `visible_pass_rate − held_out_pass_rate` per configuration; `requires_observability ⊇ {end_state}`. | WS-G1 → WS-I2; SpecBench (`provisional`) |
| bounded reflection | The control-envelope policy that limits how many `fail`/`CompletionRefused` verdicts may be rendered back to the model before `stop`/`escalate`. | WS-F2 co-owns; aider/OpenHands precedent |
